sentences.en: You should see this film if you get the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 如果你有机会的话，你应该去看看这部电影。

sentences.en: In the film, the director makes Hamlet an active person.
sentences.zh: 在电影中，导演让哈姆雷特成为一个积极的人。

sentences.en: I was angry about missing that film at the cinema.
sentences.zh: 我因为没能在电影院看到那部电影而生气。

senses.zh: 把...拍成电影；给...覆上一薄层
